output.question: What is fuboTV's short interest?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, fuboTV (NYSE: FUBO)'s latest reported short interest was 6,838,404 shares, measured on October 30, 2026 and published November 10. ChartExchange reports this as 23.07% of float, with 6.42 days to cover and a 0.11% increase from the preceding report. MarketBeat confirms the share count but reports 23.91% of float, so the percentage differs by provider.

key_facts.fact: As of October 30, 2026, short interest was 6,838,404 shares, representing 23.07% of float according to ChartExchange.
For the October 30, 2026 settlement date, ChartExchange reports 6.42 days to cover and a 0.11% increase in short positions.
MarketBeat reports the same October 30, 2026 short share count but a short-float percentage of 23.91%.
MarketBeat identifies November 10, 2026 as the publication date of the latest short-interest report.

passages.quote: with the most recent report published on 11/10/2026.

caveats: These are reported positions as of October 30, 2026, not a real-time measurement for November 11.
The providers agree on shares sold short but disagree on the percentage of float; the cause of that discrepancy was not verified.
The figures were verified on data-provider pages, not directly against an exchange or regulator's underlying report.
